stand + push recovery (MuJoCo, CAD mass properties)

Stands 10 s with balance ON: True; recovers from 0.2 s pushes up to 125 N forward / 125 N sideways (v2 capsule model: 175 N). COM +21 mm from the ankle axis (foot centre +60 mm, heel −60, toe +180). Plain PD (balance OFF) does NOT stand: it holds about 4 s, then sinks and falls before 10 s, because the capped joint gains in series (hip, knee, ankle) are softer than the gravity stiffness m·g·h. That is a controller limit, not a COM problem.
stands with balance controller OFF (plain joint PD only)
holds ~4 s then falls before 10 s; COM +21 mm ahead of ankle axis (inside the foot), so this is joint-gain softness, not geometry. Real robots always run balance.

summary: Bryan asked for a design that would hold up in the real world. v3 replaces every estimated actuator part with a catalog part (Kollmorgen TBM2G, Harmonic Drive CSG, Rollvis RV, IKO CRBH, Everest XCR, RLS AksIM-2, maxon, Molicel), adds bolts, bearings, cable drums, fins and a tendon hand to the CAD, and re-checks thermal, life, fall, fatigue and FEA. The loop started with 13 failures; 63.8 kg after fixes.
